about_the_game:
Welcome to Dead Beyond – where the instinct to survive is no longer a choice, but your only reality.

In Dead Beyond, you awaken disoriented and imprisoned inside a deranged maze of horrors. A vengeful madman has abducted you, and his thirst for revenge has turned this once-abandoned house into a custom-built nightmare. This isn't just a hideout—it's a twisted, living trap designed to torment and destroy you.

Zombies roam the dark corridors, groaning and hungry for flesh. Death lurks around every corner—through cleverly concealed traps, mind-bending puzzles, and sinister surprises that challenge your reflexes and your sanity. Each room has a purpose. Each corridor hides a secret. And every mistake could be your last.

To survive, you’ll have to think fast, act faster, and trust your instincts. There’s no map. No mercy. Just you, your wits, and the overwhelming terror that threatens to consume you. Will you fight your way through, or become one more forgotten victim?

🎮 Game Overview:

Dead Beyond is a First-Person Survival Horror game that blends intense combat, atmospheric storytelling, and spine-chilling jump scares. But this isn’t just another zombie shooter—it’s a psychological gauntlet.

Explore a house that feels alive, shifting with every level. Each floor presents new challenges, forcing you to adapt. One level might demand pure combat as zombies swarm in droves. Another may trap you in pitch-black corridors with nothing but your senses to guide you. And others may test your mind with intricate platforming or logic puzzles where failure means death.

🔥 Key Features:

  • Heart-pounding survival horror with unpredictable zombie encounters and terrifying jump scares.

  • Dynamic level design – Each section of the house offers unique challenges, traps, and puzzles.

  • Blended gameplay mechanics – A mix of survival horror and first-person platforming for a diverse experience.

  • Story-driven revenge narrative – Discover the twisted reason behind your kidnapping and uncover the identity of your tormentor.

  • Atmospheric sound and lighting – Every creak, groan, and shadow plays with your mind.

Prepare yourself. This house wasn’t built for comfort.
It was built for revenge.
Escape is not guaranteed.
Welcome to Dead Beyond.

content_descriptors.notes: Basically Player only kills zombies walking inside the game and attacking our player. But there are lots of blood effects when zombies are shot or if our player is attacked and injured by the zombies or traps.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 14393.102 or higher
  • Processor: Intel i5-2550K, 3.4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 670 | Radeon HD 7950
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 14393.102 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3770, 3.4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 970 or GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Dead Beyond is an action packed survival game where you  are trapped in a house full of zombies and challenging traps to overcome.
